summary: This informational report captures the results of the second ForCES interoperability test, held on February 24-25, 2011 at the Internet Technology Lab at Zhejiang Gongshang University in China. The first test was reported in RFC 6053, which this report updates with further results.

eli5.summary: Different teams brought their own router-part software to see if it works together. This writes down how it went.
